title: Dictionary entry (one line of lexicon.jsonl)
description: One record per line of lexicon.jsonl: w is toned IPA, p is the per-character phone sequence, g is the gloss, pg is the source locator.

w.description: Toned IPA word form; tones use superscript digits, e.g. 'loŋ⁵⁵', 'a²¹pa²¹'.

p.description: Per-character phone sequence, space separated, e.g. 'l o ŋ'; equals the cleaned and detoned w.

g.description: Gloss. Chinese dictionaries use Chinese; public packs may carry English only.

pos.description: Part of speech, one Chinese character (名/动/副/量/数/代/助/连/后缀...); empty string when unannotated.

pg.description: Source locator. Single-dictionary use: 'page_0123'. Pack use: '<pack_id>#<row>', e.g. 'pack-a#1386'.

src.description: Source pack id. Optional for single-dictionary entries; required for provenance after merging.

src_head.description: Original headword in the source file, before transliteration.

ye.description: Yedshu-Peng (1984) spelling; optional, for display and manual checking.

variants.description: Alternative spellings or grammatical variants (future / perfect).

sense.description: Sense number for the same form; identical forms from different packs keep their own sense.
